title: Content uses only the left two thirds; right third is empty studs
detail: Index, Eggs, Shop, Potions and Settings all stop at about x=840 of a 1250 px window; the rest is a bare stud field, so every menu looks unfinished.
fix: Lay content out to the window width with the docs/232 helpers (grid columns grow, inset 16, gutter 12) or size the window to its content.
note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: The X hangs on the header corner
detail: The red X overlaps the strip outline and the frame on every window (owner noticed).
fix: X fully inside the strip, centred, equal 8 px inset (in the BD-1189 pilot brief).
note: PR #583 pilot skin, X inside the strip in every window, seen in Studio runs 2-4

title: Header strip is a long empty bar with a small left title
detail: Title is small and left, the striped strip runs empty to the X; top games put a bigger title with an icon and keep the strip short or centred.
fix: Title 28 px with the place icon, strip only as wide as needed or centred title.

title: Side rail broken: only POTIONS and a shield float at the top centre
detail: Dinos, Eggs, Fusion, Shop and Settings buttons are missing; POTIONS and the shield sit over the SIZE bar area at the short viewport.
fix: Fix the rail layout for short landscape screens (vertical rail on the left edge, all six, 44 px min).
note: fixed, seen in Studio run 2 (2026-11-14)

title: HUD buttons in four styles
detail: LEAP (blue, icon, two lines "[E] ready"), CHOMP (green, F badge), HOME (big red) and the weather pill each look different; red HOME reads as danger.
fix: One HUD button style from the kit: same height, icon + one word, key hint as a small badge; HOME grey or blue.
note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: Hint text floats on the world with no plate
detail: "Eat food to grow. Bigger dinos find eggs!" sits under an empty dark SIZE capsule; hard to read on bright grass.
fix: Put the objective on a small cream plate with an icon; show SIZE as a filled bar with a dino icon.

title: Bottom bar cut off at short screens
detail: At 1274x481 the progress bar, page arrows and FUSION button are clipped under the window edge.

title: Undiscovered cards repeat "??? / ???" and black blobs

fix: One "?" line, soft tinted silhouette, a hint where to find it (rarity colour edge).

title: Oversized Explore button and nested boxes
detail: A huge green Explore block, a cyan banner and a cyan AUTO button stack inside a dark box inside the window; three button colours on one screen.
fix: One primary button (Explore, normal 48 px height), banner as plain text, AUTO as a toggle chip; one panel.
note: fixed, seen in Studio run 2 (2026-11-14)

title: Nest slots are tiny icons in heavy frames
detail: Five slots show a small nest icon over an "Empty" pill in a dark frame; nothing inviting.
fix: Bigger nest art per slot, soft empty state, the count as a chip.

title: Price text overlaps the crystal icon

note: PR #584 502893aa, seen in Studio 2026-11-14

title: Long helper line for a kid
detail: "Switch dinos in Dinos to style another one" is long and abstract.
fix: "Styling: Compy" with a small "Change" button.

title: Prime Feast has a blank blue square instead of a picture
detail: The Rare potion card shows an empty blue tile where the bottle should be.
fix: Bind or make the missing potion icon; a missing icon should fall back to the generic bottle, never a blank tile.
note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: Grey price buttons look disabled

note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: Footer text clipped and on studs

fix: Move to a panel footer or a small info button.
note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: Opening Fusion shows an empty window titled "Potion Shop"
detail: open("fusion") through the shared window gave an empty purple window with the previous title; the Fusion Menu is its own window. Verify the rail path does not do this.
fix: Route "fusion" to FusionMenu everywhere; the shared window never shows an empty body; set the title on every open.
note: fixed, seen in Studio run 2 (2026-11-14)

title: Rows sit on studs, values far right
detail: Labels, sliders and percents are placed on the stud field; RESET SOUND and ON are different sizes; the cyan SOUND LAB is a dev tool shown to kids.
fix: Settings rows on one panel, slider + value together, hide SOUND LAB outside Studio/admin.
note: PR shop/potions branches, seen in Studio run 7

title: No daily login reward or streak
detail: Top games give a reward every day with a growing streak (3-7-21); Be Dino has none (docs/235).
fix: Daily streak calendar in the lobby: crystals and an egg on day 3 / 7, PROVISIONAL amounts, server time, flag-gated.

title: No playtime rewards
detail: Nearly every top game hands out gifts at 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 minutes in a session; none here.
fix: Playtime gift track on the HUD (small chest with a timer), rewards PROVISIONAL, flag-gated.

title: Runs are about 5 minutes (under 6 min = low Day-1)
detail: GameAnalytics 2025: 0-6 minute sessions fall under 10% Day-1; hits at 19+ minutes.
fix: One-tap "Play again" after the hatch, a run-streak bonus, and lobby goals so a session holds 3+ runs.

title: Objectives built but switched off
detail: ObjectivesEnabled is false in Config; quests are a top retention driver.
fix: Turn Objectives on in the playtest profile after a Studio check; add a daily set.

title: No friends-in-server bonus
detail: Top games boost luck or coins when playing with friends; we only count friends for telemetry.
fix: Small luck bonus per friend in the server (capped), shown on the HUD.

title: No Roblox badges
detail: No BadgeService badges for first hatch, first Rare, Index milestones.
fix: Badge set for key moments (badge creation is the owner account step).

title: Index completion gives no reward
detail: Collection progress is shown but finishing species or tiers gives nothing.
fix: Index milestones (5 / 10 / 20 species) give crystals, a nest or a title.

title: No return notification when a nest is ready
detail: Roblox experience notifications bring players back ("your egg is ready").
fix: Opt-in experience notification when a nest finishes (owner sets up the notification string).

title: No player codes or group reward
detail: Top games use social codes and a join-the-group bonus to grow.
fix: Code box in Settings (server-validated list) and a one-time group bonus; flag-gated.

title: Price icon lands inside the word after the BD-1192 fix
detail: With the Toybox skin on, the amber icon sits at x=687 inside "3,700 Crystals" (text at 652); offline checks passed, Studio shows the overlap.

title: Empty nest slots show a full egg in a nest

title: Nothing new after week 1 (player sim)
detail: tools/simulate_players.py (real egg odds, 5 personas, 30 days): ~10-14 of 22 species by day 7, then new species are rare; with a "quit after N quiet visits" rule almost no persona plays on day 30, the grinder runs dry first (56% on day 7). Patterns, colours, mutations and Emerald/Diamond are not modelled yet.
fix: More "new" moments in weeks 2-4: count patterns/colours/mutations as discoveries (Index), daily quests, streak rewards, Index milestone rewards, Emerald/Diamond goals shown early; model them in the sim and re-run.
